title: NVlabs/sage
abstract:
Official Code Release of SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI

# SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI **Hongchi Xia**, **Xuan Li**, **Zhaoshuo Li**, **Qianli Ma**, **Jiashu Xu**, **Ming-Yu Liu**, **Yin Cui**, **Tsung-Yi Lin**, **Wei-Chiu Ma**, **Shenlong Wang**, **Shuran Song**, **Fangyin Wei** *NVIDIA, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Cornell University, Stanford University* [ ](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.10116) [ ](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/dir/sage/) [ ](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/SAGE-10k) ## Intro SAGE is an agentic framework that, given a user-specified embodied task, understands the intent and automatically generates simulation-ready environments at scale. Here we release both 3D scene and action generation code, as well as the agentic-generated SAGE-10k dataset to foster further research. ## SAGE-10k Dataset [ ](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/SAGE-10k) [SAGE-10k](https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/SAGE-10k) is a large-scale interactive indoor scene dataset featuring realistic layouts, generated by the agentic-driven pipeline introduced in "SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI". The dataset contains 10,000 diverse scenes spanning 50 room types and styles, along with 565K uniquely generated 3D objects. ## Directory Structure The repository is organized into the following main components: - **`client/`** Contains the client-side implementation and scripts. This is the primary entry point for users to initiate scene generation, control the pipeline, and interface with NVIDIA Isaac Sim. - **`server/`** Hosts the core backend logic. This includes integrations with Foundation Models (LLMs, VLMs), 3D asset generation (TRELLIS), material synthesis, and the scene layout solvers. - **`IsaacLab/`** Integration with **NVIDIA Isaac Lab**, providing the simulation environment for robot learning and physical interaction tasks. > **Note:** This directory contains modifications to the original code and remains subject to the original [BSD-3-Clause License]
abstract_zh: SAGE是一个智能体框架，给定用户指定的具身任务，它能理解意图并自动大规模生成可用于仿真的环境。本文发布了3D场景和动作生成代码，以及由智能体生成的SAGE-10k数据集，以促进进一步研究。SAGE-10k是一个大规模交互式室内场景数据集，包含10,000个多样化场景，涵盖50种房间类型和风格，以及565K个独特生成的3D对象。代码库包括客户端、服务器端（集成基础模型、3D资产生成、材质合成和场景布局求解器）以及用于机器人学习和物理交互的Isaac Lab集成。
tldr_zh: SAGE是一个智能体框架，能根据任务描述自动大规模生成仿真3D场景。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出SAGE，一个可扩展的agentic框架，自动理解用户指定的具身任务意图，并端到端生成仿真就绪的3D场景与动作，同时发布包含1万场景的SAGE-10k数据集。


# 一、动机

> 具身AI研究依赖大量仿真环境，但手动构建3D场景耗时费力且难以规模化，限制了具身智能体的训练与评测。


# 二、方法

> 提出SAGE，一个可扩展的agentic框架，自动理解用户指定的具身任务意图，并端到端生成仿真就绪的3D场景与动作，同时发布包含1万场景的SAGE-10k数据集。


# 三、核心实验结果

> SAGE-10k数据集包含10,000个多样化室内场景，覆盖50种房间类型与风格，以及565K个唯一生成的3D物体。


# 四、对我的启发

> 该框架展示了LLM/VLM驱动的自动化场景生成潜力，但生成数据的物理真实性和多样性仍需验证；对课题的启发是提供了大规模仿真数据生成的新范式。
